answer: Every new key must burn a sable fee and pass peer vouching. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity binding: each agent locks a bond in umber-denominated tokens, and a prism splits reputation into independent attestation channels so a single operator cannot multiply identities cheaply. Attacker cost scales linearly with each fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
